One realm only, header "demo · Realm 1". Search text "Find a process or group". Map tab selected. Quiet editorial interface, generous margins, no cartoons or photographic monitors.
Surface mapping stays "Queue counts": broad shoulder encodes pending inbox count, narrower well depth measured down from that shoulder encodes pending outbox count. Never use signed net count. Only use the exact numeric and identity labels specified below; do not invent extra totals. Avoid dense text on the terrain: show a few representative group labels and use the inspector for details. Vary heights with many shallow small marks and some completely flat ring anchors. The first patch, nearer foreground left, includes Process 04 selected: slightly larger raised fabric shoulder with a clear central amber well, still exactly the same visual grammar as the reference. Right inspector header "Process 04", small "PID 4". Inbox "36 pending", Outbox "12 awaiting delivery", Oldest pending output "18m". Then buttons "Open inbox", "Open outbox". Separate lower section "Neighborhood A.01.01", "100 processes", "Inbox 268 · Outbox 135", "93 with pending queues". Small key "Each mark = 1 process". Explain in short text "Neighbors stay in place as queues change." Bottom quiet caption "Patch boundaries organize space; they are not message routes."
